G-J3.reason: bearings agree within 30 deg on only 61.3% of episode days, below the 70% threshold

G-J5.reason: 2019: modelled seasonal severity at percentile 0.83, below 0.9 (ranked 2 of 7 modelled seasons; observed it is 0.93)

threshold.scored_on: the model's own seasonal mean risk, never trained on these years

chirps.licence: public domain — CHC: "Pete Peterson has waived all copyright ... CHIRPS data is in the public domain"
chirps.path_correction: the spec's prelim/global_daily/fixed/ is a CHIRPS-2.0 path and 404s under v3.0; v3 is daily/{final,prelim}/sat/
chirps.caveat: CHIRPS daily is a disaggregated pentad, not an independent daily observation; and a %CCD bug zeroed precipitation over Indonesia where IR data was missing, fixed in 2015

cams.alignment: the forecast comparison is aligned by ISSUE time, not valid time
cams.resolution: CAMS is coarser than the 0.25 deg model grid (EAC4 ~0.75 deg, forecasts ~0.4 deg); values are broadcast up and the page says so rather than implying detail the product does not have

attribution_granularity.decision: Province-level attribution is PUBLISHED, with the trajectory uncertainty shown beside it.  Island level was the conservative alternative and was rejected: 'Sumatra' is not an answer anyone can act on, and the whole commercial premise of this case is that the answer is actionable.  Every province share carries the ensemble spread and an explicit 'no attributable source' outcome.

licences.FIRMS: NASA — public domain / free and open
licences.CHIRPS: public domain — CHC: "Pete Peterson has waived all copyright ... CHIRPS data is in the public domain"
licences.PEATGRIDS: CC BY 4.0 — Widyastuti et al. 2025, CATENA, 10.5281/zenodo.12559239
licences.Singapore NEA: Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0 — commercial use explicitly permitted ("whether commercially or non-commercially"); attribution + no-endorsement

excluded.AQICN / Malaysia APIMS: forbids commercial use verbatim — Malaysia is a genuine hole, so the transboundary claim is Indonesia -> Singapore only
excluded.Indonesia ISPU: server-rendered, no API, no stated licence
excluded.SPEIbase: ODbL share-alike — viral-licence risk on a commercial deliverable
excluded.DLR S5P UV Aerosol Index: the collection's licence STRING says CC-BY-4.0 while the URL in that same field and the rel:license link both point at CC BY-NC 4.0 — held back pending written confirmation from DLR EOC
excluded.KLHK land cover: reachable and richer than WorldCover, but no open licence — WorldCover is the primary and KLHK is not stored
